subject: Pipe in stdout from system call

messages.author: c5d6da03b7f44001
messages.subject: Pipe in stdout from system call
parts:
Hi,

I would like to perform a system call to run an external program and pipe in the unbuffered stdout into my shiny app. I am attempting to do this via a named pipe. Basic steps: a named pipe is created, the external application is called with stdout directed to the pipe, then I use a while loop to consume each line in the pipe. The problem is that all of the lines in the pipe are rendered in the app after the loop exits, rather than line by line. I'm not sure how to restructure this in order to instruct shiny to update output$wnText with each pass through the loop.

I have the following in server.R:

    runWN <- reactive({
      if(length(input$run_wn) > 0 && input$run_wn == 1){ #check that user has requested a windninja run
         system("mkfifo wnpipe")
         system(paste("/home/natalie/windninja_trunk/build/src/cli/./WindNinja_cli", 
                "windninja.cfg >> wnpipe",
                collapse=""), intern=FALSE, wait=FALSE)
         fileName="wnpipe"
         con=fifo(fileName,open="rt",blocking=TRUE)
         linn = " "
         #linn is not printed each time cat is called, just one long string after the while loop exits
         while ( length(linn) > 0) {
           linn=scan(con,nlines=1,what="character", sep=" ", quiet=TRUE)
           cat(linn,"\n"); flush.console()
         }
         close(con)
         unlink ("wnpipe")
       }
    })

    output$wnText <- renderPrint({
         runWN()   
    })

I appreciate any suggestions.

Natalie
